operation_details.item: The user documents financial models as bullet-only shorthand labels with no formulas, assumptions, or sensitivity notes.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I can help structure the documentation for the retail expansion model. Would you like to start with the revenue build, operating expenses, or the assumptions section?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Let’s start with the assumptions section. I’m preparing a concise handoff for the planning team and want the documentation to be easy to scan.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I can organize it by store rollout, sales, labor, occupancy, working capital, capital spending, and financing inputs.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: When documenting financial models, I want bullet-only shorthand labels with no formulas, assumptions, or sensitivity notes.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I’ll use short bullet labels only, without explanatory paragraphs or calculation detail. A possible structure is: Store openings; Ramp period; Sales growth; Gross margin; Labor cost; Rent; Utilities; Inventory days; Supplier terms; Capital spending; Tax rate; Debt schedule.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That format works. Keep the labels practical for a retail expansion and group related items together.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Suggested outline: Expansion: Store openings; Opening cadence; Location mix. Revenue: Store ramp; Traffic; Conversion; Average basket. Costs: Merchandise margin; Payroll; Occupancy; Distribution. Balance sheet: Inventory; Payables; Receivables. Cash flow: Capital spending; Pre-opening costs; Taxes. Financing: Revolver; Interest; Debt repayment.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please make the labels even shorter so they can sit directly beside the model tabs in the handoff document.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Condensed version: Expansion: Openings; Cadence; Mix. Revenue: Ramp; Traffic; Conversion; Basket. Costs: Margin; Payroll; Rent; Distribution. Balance sheet: Inventory; Payables; Receivables. Cash flow: Capex; Pre-open; Taxes. Financing: Revolver; Interest; Repayment.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Use that condensed version for the assumptions tab documentation and keep the same shorthand style for future model handoffs.
